bio.text: Michael Howe has been North Dakota's Secretary of State since January 1, 2023.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Republican candidate for the office in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to the Secretary of State's office, he is a fifth-generation farmer who helps run his family's seed farm near Casselton and graduated from North Dakota State University in 2010.
Before becoming secretary of state he served as a state representative for District 22 and earlier worked in Washington, D.C., as agriculture policy director for Rep. Rick Berg.
